reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no counterparty comment, which is the expected output shape for a compliant finding.

The cited grant clauses substantively meet the preferred position: § 13.1 extends the subscription right to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf; § 13.2 gives Customer and Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, fully paid licence to delivered/embedded software and Vendor Technology with contractor support rights; § 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor and bars revocation or suspension absent a material uncured breach after notice and cure.
Deterministic checks (affiliates covered; no at-will revocation) both pass and are consistent with the cited text.

The § 14.2 'revocable, non-transferable' Deliverable licence outlier is transparently noted in the rationale and routed to the IP rule rather than double-flagged, which matches the playbook's no-double-flagging and 'note minor sub-elements' guidance; it does not defeat the LICENSE rule's material terms given § 13.3's no-revocation covenant.
No indication of over- or under-flagging: the clause benefits our party and no actionable deviation exists to raise.
